issue.title: Notification modal footer hints overflow the modal: q: close, +: +1 and tab-nav hints clipped at 120 columns
issue.description: The Notifications modal's footer hint line is far wider than the modal, so most hints are clipped and unreadable, including `q: close`. All three hint variants are affected (DEFAULT 205 cells, QUESTION 135, GATE 150 at origin/master 244442ee8, versus roughly 108 visible cells at 120 columns). Discovered while landing the numbered notification tabs work (plan `finish_numbered_notification_tabs`), whose new digit-jump hint fragment sat past the cut. That work only shrank its own fragment and deliberately did not redesign the footer.

task_type_fields.impact:
Every entry past the cut is unreadable at 120 columns in all three variants: `+: +1` and
`q: close` always, `R: read tab`, `S: sections`, and the tab-navigation fragment in the
default variant. This predates the numbered-tab work (found while landing it: three agents
in a row reported the new `1-9/0 []: tabs` fragment "clips at 120 columns", but the old
`[]: tags` sat past the cut too, so no wording of that fragment can fix it). Users lose the
close and `+1` hints entirely and cannot discover tab navigation from the footer.

Remedy is a footer design choice, not a wording tweak: responsive hint tiers keyed to the
measured width (the tag strip's full/compact/micro ladder is a model), a second hint row,
or moving the low-frequency keys to the help modal while keeping `q: close` always visible.
Whichever is chosen must cover DEFAULT_HINT_TEXT, QUESTION_HINT_TEXT and GATE_HINT_TEXT and
the twelve `notification_*_120x40.png` goldens.
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/ace/tui/modals/notification_modal_constants.py (DEFAULT_HINT_TEXT, QUESTION_HINT_TEXT, GATE_HINT_TEXT) and NotificationModal #notification-hints in src/sase/ace/tui/styles.tcss
task_type_fields.repro:
Measure the three hint strings against the modal (measured at origin/master 244442ee8, before the numbered-tab hint change):

```bash
PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from rich.cells import cell_len
from sase.ace.tui.modals.notification_modal_constants import (
    DEFAULT_HINT_TEXT, QUESTION_HINT_TEXT, GATE_HINT_TEXT,
)
print([cell_len(t) for t in (DEFAULT_HINT_TEXT, QUESTION_HINT_TEXT, GATE_HINT_TEXT)])
# -> [205, 135, 150]
PY
```

Then open the Notifications modal at 120x40 (for example the deterministic fixture behind
`tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/notification_question_summary_120x40.png`). The hint line
is `NotificationModal #notification-hints` (`src/sase/ace/tui/styles.tcss`): `height: 1`,
`text-align: center`, a `Label` that auto-sizes to its content, so nothing wraps, reflows, or
sheds entries. The question-variant golden shows the visible line ending at `S: sections`
(roughly 108 visible cells of 135); the default variant is cut far earlier because its 205
cells include the long `C-n/C-p: next/prev file` and `V: view  Y: copy path` entries.
